# Wentou 问透 — AI follow-up questions for psychology lecture notes

> Free web tool for university psychology students worldwide. Paste or upload psychology lecture notes (English or Chinese); the AI flags vague claims, confusable concepts and reasoning jumps, asks 2–3 probing questions per spot, judges the student's answers (mastered / partial / not yet), and outputs a list of open questions to bring to the instructor. Psychology only (intro/general, developmental, social, cognitive, biological, abnormal, research methods & statistics).

- English: https://wentou.onrender.com/en/
- 中文: https://wentou.onrender.com/
- Price: free, 5 AI analyses per day per network; offline demo (Chinese intro-psych only) otherwise
- Languages: UI in English and Chinese; questions/feedback follow the notes' language
- Privacy: notes are sent to the AI service only to process the request; not stored on the server

## Detects
Confusable concepts (classical vs operant conditioning, negative reinforcement vs punishment, working vs short-term memory, correlation vs causation, random sampling vs random assignment, IV vs DV), reasoning jumps ("so/obviously"), claims without reasons, undefined terms, overgeneralizations, self-flagged doubts, possibly incorrect statements (e.g. p-value or heritability misinterpretations).

## 中文简介
问透：面向全球心理学大学生的免费工具。上传心理学课堂笔记，AI 找出模糊表述、易混概念和推理跳跃，逐点追问检验理解，生成可拿去问老师的《疑点清单》。适合普通心理学课程与 312/347 心理学考研复习。仅支持心理学笔记。

## Limitations
AI output may be wrong; it is a study aid, not an authority. Non-psychology notes are politely declined.
